notes: The app now asks the vision endpoint what model it serves instead of assuming. vLLM rejects any name it did not register, and the registered name depends on how the endpoint was created — paste a Hugging Face URL into RunPod's model box and the served name can be that URL rather than the repository id, which returns a 404 on every request while the GPU sits there perfectly healthy. On that error the endpoint's model list is fetched, the Vision model field is corrected to what it actually serves, and the request is retried once. Test vision endpoint checks the same thing up front and fixes the field before spending a job on the wrong name.
